'''Cleven''' was a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who was an associate of [[Gideon (spacer)|Gideon]], [[Keeta]], and [[Pyrron Nox]]. Eight [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after Cleven was killed, Gideon rumbled a [[Shi'ido]] posing as Nox by pretending Cleven was still alive and on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]].<ref name="SS" />
